name: OVERTAKE
description: In 2019, Justin Grimm sold his previous company to a private equity firm. Very soon after, he realized that the original values of the company started to slip away. He also realized this was not only happening with his own company, it was unfortunately becoming a frequent thing in the aftermarket community. He saw the soul of the automotive scene slipping away. The smaller shops, the craftsmanship, the community-focused values — all were being overshadowed by corporate giants more interested in profits than passion. So, he took a step back, reimagined the future, and founded OVERTAKE to give enthusiasts, like you, the parts, service, and attention to detail that you deserve.
